packet.name: DMX-TP-DOPECODE-PHASE6-CODEX-001
packet.objective: Strengthen dopeCode semantic certainty and operator-facing approval/execution receipts without widening mutation authority or weakening verified Phase 5 language and policy guarantees.

implementation_notes.semantic_scope: find_callees now returns structured semantic certainty and explicit unresolved reason codes for supported Python, JavaScript, and bounded TypeScript paths.
implementation_notes.approval_scope: approval_receipt now exposes operator-usable execution status, risk tier, reason, and affected file summary without moving approval authority into dopeCode.
implementation_notes.planning_scope: Preview refactor responses now include a deterministic refactor_plan receipt for supported rename and body replacement flows.

finding_summary: Initial semantic_summary counters double-counted unresolved results; summary keys were separated into non-overlapping status and certainty count fields.

constraints_observed: Workspace boundary checks remain in WriteLayer.
Preview paths remain non-mutating in write and refactor flows.
Unsupported semantic cases remain fail closed.
remaining_limits: Semantic certainty remains bounded to parser-visible and workspace-local evidence.
Import resolution remains workspace-local and source-directory-relative.
Inline JavaScript and TypeScript arrow-expression bodies remain fail closed for replace_symbol_body.
Broader repository drift outside the dopeCode slice remains unverified.
